claims.description: Both terminal handlers persist the PII-minimized signal before transport, acknowledge only confirmed sends, and have immediate plus scheduled retry/recovery paths keyed by one deterministic id.
Migration 0164 defines the first-party durable outbox with constrained event/error names and no identity foreign key because deletion may already be complete.

Focused tests cover immediate rejection, timeout then late resolution, timeout then late rejection, and duplicate-safe recovery/replay; production revert fails and exact restore passes with matching SHA-256 hashes.
Retention evidence cites current first-party outbox, timeout-not-cancellation, replay/sweep ownership, and WI-1916's downstream-only scope.
The launch-health runbook documents persistence-before-send, confirmation-only acknowledgement, five-retry immediate replay, five-minute recovery, and deterministic dedupe.

Existing deletion, Clerk erasure, subscription-store teardown, manual remediation, and privacy-minimized payload behavior remain covered by the focused handler tests; no environment or provider mutation occurred.
